topArticle.title: Trump administration diverts human rights funds to push far-right agenda abroad

Support such as for white Afrikaners and anti-communism reveals how US is redefining what qualifies as human rights
With hours left before the funding expires, the Trump administration is pushing to direct more than $175m of the state department’s flagship human rights fund to a slate of awards that includes a huge $40m grant for an anti-communism fund, support for a group advancing white Afrikaner rights in South Africa, a campaign against Brazil’s supreme court and programs that would reward ideological allies in Europe who protect “western civilizational norms”.
On Wednesday, the state department obligated the funds to the grantees hours before the deadline despite congressional concerns and requests not to do so, according to a source familiar with the negotiations. The state department declined to comment on questions from the Guardian specifically on whether it had obligated the funds and had “blown” holds from Congress due to concerns about the money’s use.

topArticle.summary: アルゼンチンのミレイ大統領がフォークランド諸島を巡る「変化の風」を約束する中、ドナルド・トランプ氏が英国の統治に対する姿勢を変えるかどうかが注目されている。

topArticle.title: Ecuador detains former minister José Serrano after U.S. deportation
topArticle.description: Deported from the United States, Ecuador’s former “superminister” now faces grave criminal investigations and political accusations in a justice system facing questions over due process.
topArticle.titleJa: エクアドル、米国追放後のホセ・セラーノ元大臣を拘束
topArticle.summary: 米国から追放されたエクアドルのホセ・セラーノ元大臣が重大な刑事捜査と政治的告発に直面。司法制度の適正手続きが問われている。

topArticle.title: ‘Pay-by-the-day’ living in Pereira: The forgotten survivors of Colombia’s earthquake
topArticle.description: In Pereira, Colombia, earthquake survivors living in pay-by-the-day rooms now face homelessness, overcrowded shelters, illness, and a struggle to be counted.
topArticle.titleJa: ペレイラの「日払い」生活：コロンビア地震の忘れられた生存者たち
topArticle.summary: コロンビアのペレイラで、地震の生存者たちが日払いの部屋に暮らし、ホームレス、過密な避難所、病気に直面。存在を認識されずに苦闘している。

topArticle.title: Pakistan launches deadly air strikes on Afghanistan
topArticle.description: The Afghan Taliban says nine civilians have died while Pakistan says the strikes killed 22 militants.

topArticle.summary: パキスタンがアフガニスタンに空爆を行い、タリバンは民間人9人の死亡を報告。パキスタン側は武装勢力22人を殺害したと主張。

topArticle.title: Singapore launches matchmaking service for government workers
topArticle.description: The launch of FirstDate comes as the ageing nation wrestles with a record-low fertility rate.

topArticle.summary: シンガポール政府は、少子高齢化問題への対策として、公務員向けにお見合いサービス「FirstDate」を開始した。

topArticle.title: Watch: Couple describe relief at rescue after whale destroys their yacht
topArticle.description: Jeremy and Jemma Cooper were 500 miles off the coast of New Zealand when their yacht, the Tai Tam, collided with a sperm whale.
topArticle.titleJa: クジラにヨットを破壊され救助された夫婦が安堵を語る
topArticle.summary: ニュージーランド沖500マイルで、ヨットがマッコウクジラと衝突し破壊された。救助されたジェレミーとジェマ・クーパー夫妻がその安堵を語った。

topArticle.title: WTO, Asian Development Bank and World Bank bring TS4D initiative to Asia and the Pacific
topArticle.description: The WTO, the Asian Development Bank and the World Bank Group jointly organized a regional conference in Manila on 28-29 September that brought for the first time the Trade in Services for Development (TS4D) initiative to the Asia-Pacific region. The event allowed trade officials and other stakeholders from the region to discuss the role of services trade in development, exchange views on the use of analytical tools developed under the initiative and share best practices and policy approaches for supporting services trade in the region.
topArticle.titleJa: WTO、アジア開発銀行、世界銀行がアジア太平洋地域にTS4Dイニシアティブを導入
topArticle.summary: WTO、ADB、世界銀行がマニラで地域会議を開催し、開発のためのサービス貿易（TS4D）イニシアティブをアジア太平洋地域に初めて導入した。
